rule: A creature's AI type (ai_file_id, from the npcs table in the client pack) picks one of a few combat classes. Three of them (archer, big monster, wild boar) each come in a roaming and a hold-position form that share one combat behaviour and differ only in default idle. Health is an integer percent. Active move lists are gated by a health range (minimum exclusive, maximum inclusive, (0,0) always on), a time window since combat start, and a weighted pick by dice. A wild boar opens with one start skill and, below a percent threshold, uses a spurt move in place of its basic attack when in range. A creature stat is a formula of level, template, kind and grade, then bonuses applied in list order. Grade and kind are formula inputs, not behaviour switches. Group formation offsets and tension are loaded but not read anywhere in the server half.

keep: two-stance split: roam and hold share one combat behaviour, differing only in default idle
health-band move list with a weight, and a (0,0) always-on entry
spurt move that replaces the basic attack below a percent threshold
filter first (cooldown, range, health), then pick once (BigMonsterAttackBehavior 91-97)
grade and kind as formula inputs, not as behaviour switches
change: gates disagree on the boundary: BaseCombatBehavior treats the minimum as exclusive, BigMonsterAttackBehavior as inclusive; use one rule and one helper
wild-boar spurt loop calls the fallback once per entry (WildBoarAttackBehavior 96-117); pick once after the loop
wild-boar spurt does nothing when the target is out of spurt range; fall through to the normal pick
spurt has no latch; decide whether it fires per crossing or while below threshold, and state it
percent and flat bonuses apply in list order (Npc.cs 156-162; Unit.cs 694); sum flats first, then percent
grade values are not ordinal (NpcGradeType.cs 5-12); use an explicit ordered tier table if grades are compared
group formation fields are loaded but not read in the server half; do not build the fight loop on them until a consumer exists
look_test: Three creatures at 375 wide with our own art or boxes: a hold-stance ranged creature at its idle point; a roaming charge creature that switches to a heavier move below 70 percent health; a boss with three health bands drawing a different move list per band. Dom judges whether stance reads from idle alone, and whether the band change reads without a health bar, tested on both sides of each band edge.
